client/src/components/editor/SourceContr.name: Version control panel
client/src/components/editor/SourceContr.description: Works like a desktop code client: shows changes, commits them and syncs with GitHub.

client/src/components/editor/SourceContr.name: Source cleanup prompts
client/src/components/editor/SourceContr.description: Asks before files are discarded or removed from version control.

client/src/components/editor/SourceContr.name: Connect version control
client/src/components/editor/SourceContr.description: Guides someone through connecting the workspace to a shared code repository.

client/src/components/editor/SourceContr.name: Version control status
client/src/components/editor/SourceContr.description: Shows the current branch, whether it is behind, and any merge in progress.

client/src/components/editor/SourceDisca.name: Discard changes
client/src/components/editor/SourceDisca.description: Confirms throwing away changes to a fixed set of files.

client/src/components/editor/SourceOpera.name: Version control dialog
client/src/components/editor/SourceOpera.description: Runs one version control action and reports whether it worked.

client/src/components/editor/StatusBar.t.name: Editor status bar
client/src/components/editor/StatusBar.t.description: Shows the open file, cursor position and save state along the bottom.

client/src/components/editor/SyncDiffCon.name: Sync choices
client/src/components/editor/SyncDiffCon.description: Offers the options for reconciling a file that changed on both sides.

client/src/components/editor/SyncDiffVie.name: Sync comparison
client/src/components/editor/SyncDiffVie.description: Shows both versions of a changed file so someone can reconcile them.

client/src/components/editor/TerminalExe.name: Run result
client/src/components/editor/TerminalExe.description: Shows the outcome of a run in the output area.

client/src/components/editor/TerminalLog.name: Output line
client/src/components/editor/TerminalLog.description: Shows one line of run output, turning links into clickable text.

client/src/components/editor/TerminalPan.name: Output panel
client/src/components/editor/TerminalPan.description: Shows the log output of the workflow or script that was run.

client/src/components/editor/TerminalRes.name: Rich result window
client/src/components/editor/TerminalRes.description: Shows a run's formatted result, such as a rendered report, in a popup.

client/src/components/editor/UnsavedFile.name: Unsaved files
client/src/components/editor/UnsavedFile.description: Lists the open files that still have unsaved changes.

client/src/components/editor/UnsavedTabs.name: Unsaved tabs prompt
client/src/components/editor/UnsavedTabs.description: Asks whether to save, discard or cancel when closing files with changes.

client/src/components/editor/WorkflowDea.name: Workflow deactivation warning
client/src/components/editor/WorkflowDea.description: Warns that saving a file would switch off workflows that are still in use.

client/src/components/editor/WorkflowIdC.name: Workflow clash warning
client/src/components/editor/WorkflowIdC.description: Warns that saving a file would replace existing workflows and lose their history.

client/src/components/file-tree/adapters.name: App file actions
client/src/components/file-tree/adapters.description: Carries out file actions inside an app's own code folder.

client/src/components/file-tree/adapters.name: Workspace file actions
client/src/components/file-tree/adapters.description: Carries out file actions across the shared workspace.

client/src/components/file-tree/FileTree.name: Shared file tree
client/src/components/file-tree/FileTree.description: Shows files and folders as a tree that works for workspace files and app code alike.

client/src/components/file-tree/FileTree.name: File list error
client/src/components/file-tree/FileTree.description: Says a folder's contents could not be loaded and offers a retry.

client/src/components/file-tree/icons.ts.name: File icons
client/src/components/file-tree/icons.ts.description: Picks the right icon for each file based on what kind of item it is.

client/src/components/file-tree/index.ts.name: File tree parts
client/src/components/file-tree/index.ts.description: Gathers the reusable file tree pieces used by the editors.

client/src/components/file-tree/types.ts.name: File tree definitions
client/src/components/file-tree/types.ts.description: Defines the shared shape of files and folders used by every file tree.

client/src/components/file-tree/useFileT.name: File tree state
client/src/components/file-tree/useFileT.description: Keeps each folder's expanded state, loaded contents and refresh behaviour.

client/src/components/file-tree/validati.name: File naming rules
client/src/components/file-tree/validati.description: Checks that a new file sits in an allowed folder and follows the app's naming rules.

client/src/components/file-tree/Workspac.name: Workspace files tree
client/src/components/file-tree/Workspac.description: Shows the shared workspace's files with the actions the editor needs.

client/src/components/window-management/.name: Window animations
client/src/components/window-management/.description: Sets the slide and fade effects used when editor windows open, shrink and close.

client/src/components/window-management/.name: Window parts
client/src/components/window-management/.description: Gathers the pieces that manage editor windows and the dock.

client/src/components/window-management/.name: Window definitions
client/src/components/window-management/.description: Defines the shared shapes for docked and full-screen windows.

client/src/components/window-management/.name: Window dock
client/src/components/window-management/.description: Collects minimised editor windows into one bar at the bottom.

client/src/components/window-management/.name: Dock item
client/src/components/window-management/.description: Shows one minimised window in the dock, with a way to reopen it.

client/src/components/window-management/.name: Full-screen window
client/src/components/window-management/.description: Animates a window expanding to fill the screen and shrinking back.
